summary: Verified against the actual git history (git log/diff on HEAD, not the self-report): this task's real, unique contribution is only 2 commits totaling 72 lines -- ai-os/boss/ACTIVE-CLAIMS.yaml (a claim-registration entry for an unrelated, separately-scoped CRM/PROJEXA initiative, administrative and harmless) and src/lib/services/construction-reports-service.ts (the actual category-boq-amounts report: a new categoryBoqAmountsReport() function plus its REPORT_REGISTRY entry). That function is correct and well-scoped: it gates on requireConstructionEnabled() and runs inside withTenantContext() exactly like its 17 sibling report functions in the same file, resolves the latest non-superseded BOQ the same way scopeReport() does, attributes each line item to a category via activityId -> activity.categoryId -> category (the only path available, since constructionBoqLineItems has no direct category column), and routes any line item with a missing/deleted-category activity into an explicit uncategorizedAmount bucket rather than silently dropping it -- so categorized + uncategorized always reconciles to the BOQ total, matching scopeReport's totalValue for the same project. No raw SQL, no auth bypass, no tenant-isolation gap. This is safe, additive, tier1-appropriate work and is approved. Separately, and importantly: the diff supplied for this review contained ~110 additional lines (bun.lock, package.json, playwright.config.ts, mother-router.ts, llm-client.ts, task-execution-engine.ts) that are NOT part of this task's actual commits -- I confirmed every one of those lines already exists byte-identical in the current repo HEAD, merged there by earlier, unrelated work (the E2E CI/@playwright-test fix PR #505, and the TASK 1.2/1.3 prompt-cache wiring). The review diff was evidently generated against a stale base predating those merges rather than current main. In this specific case it's a functional no-op (identical content merges cleanly, no regression risk), so it doesn't change the verdict on the real change, but the diff-generation step that fed this review is unreliable and should be fixed before being trusted for tier classification on a future task where the stale content might not be identical.
issues: Diff supplied for review does not match the actual PR commits: git diff HEAD~2..HEAD shows only ai-os/boss/ACTIVE-CLAIMS.yaml and src/lib/services/construction-reports-service.ts changed (72 lines total), but the review diff also included bun.lock/package.json/playwright.config.ts/mother-router.ts/llm-client.ts/task-execution-engine.ts changes that are already merged into current HEAD from earlier, unrelated commits (E2E CI fix #505, TASK 1.2/1.3 prompt-cache work) -- the diff was computed against a stale base. Recommend fixing whatever generated this diff (likely risk-tier.py's or the PR-diff tool's merge-base resolution) so future audits and tier classifications are computed against current main, not a stale point-in-time.
